name: Itoham Yonekyu Holdings Inc.
summary: Itoham Yonekyu Holdings Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of processed meat and processed/precooked food products in Japan. The company operates in two segments: Processed Food Division and Meat Division. It offers ham, sausages, cooked, and processed foods products. The company was founded in 1928 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
